tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search public fixed-total service offers (the treatment field takes a service type slug). No authorization needed. Prices are fixed totals in USD cents with a price_valid_until time.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Read one public offer by service_id. No authorization needed.

tools.name: find_services
tools.description: Find providers that offer a service in a place, at any price basis: fixed total, per unit, diagnostic visit, estimate or quote. location is a market slug (atlanta, austin), a ZIP, a city or a county. tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Read one provider's complete public service catalog, optionally resolving q against its service vocabulary. Includes stable ids, descriptions, turnaround, price model, quantity basis, provenance, requestability and explicit unknowns. No authorization needed.

tools.description: Read one public service by provider_slug and stable service_id. tools.name: prepare_booking
tools.description: Prepare a checkout link for the customer. No sign-in or grant needed. Returns checkout_url and booking_token. tools.name: prepare_checkout
tools.description: Prepare one private, expiring link (handoff_url) that opens an exact checkout for the customer: provider, service and size or grade, quantity, car, drop-off time, drop-off or pickup, the price lines, total and terms, plus any name and email the customer authorized you to share. tools.name: create_booking_request
tools.description: Send a booking request for the authorized customer. This is a request, not a confirmed appointment. Reusing the same idempotency_key with the same input returns the same booking.

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Read a booking's status. Send booking_token (from prepare_booking) alone, or, with the customer's agent grant as Authorization: Bearer, exactly one of booking_id or the idempotency_key used to create it. Never both authorities.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking. Send booking_token (from prepare_booking) with idempotency_key, or, with the customer's agent grant as Authorization: Bearer, booking_id with idempotency_key. Never both authorities. Repeating the same cancel returns the same result.

tools.name: change_booking
tools.description: Changing or rescheduling a booking is not supported and always returns unsupported_operation. Cancel and create a new request instead.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service, get_vehicle_offers · Private data: prepare_booking, prepare_checkout · Public sink: prepare_checkout, create_booking_request, get_booking_status, cancel_booking, send_booking_feedback · Destructive: prepare_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service, get_vehicle_offers · Private data: prepare_booking, prepare_checkout · Public sink: prepare_checkout, create_booking_request, get_booking_status, cancel_booking, send_booking_feedback · Destructive: prepare_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
